## Mauna Nani

Gatlinburg, TN, United States



16 guests

7 bedrooms

4 bathrooms

Welcome to Mauna Nani, a brand-new, custom-built luxury cabin where breathtaking Smoky Mountain views meet modern design and upscale comfort. With 7 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and sleeps 16 guests, this home was thoughtfully designed for families, friends, and groups who want the perfect mix of relaxation and entertainment.

### Good to know

Plan your perfect spring escape at our cozy cabin, where fresh mountain air, blooming landscapes, and peaceful surroundings create the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. Start your mornings on the porch with a cup of coffee, take in the sights and sounds of nature coming back to life, and unwind as the sun sets behind the mountains. Your springtime retreat is waiting. Come make it yours!

From the moment you enter, you’ll be greeted by a large, beautiful tree fountain, a unique feature that immediately sets the tone for your stay. The soothing sound of water pairs perfectly with the soaring ceilings, custom finishes, and walls of windows that frame the mountains. The main level is the heart of the home, featuring a spacious living room with a seasonal electric fireplace and Smart TV, and opening onto expansive decks with outdoor dining and lounge seating. Just off the deck, the game room brings non-stop fun with a full-size pool table that flips into air hockey, foosball, and six multi-game arcade consoles. Nearby, a private home theater is ready for unforgettable movie nights. Two king bedrooms, each with Smart TVs and spa-like bathrooms featuring custom vanities and heated toilet seats, complete this floor.

The kitchen at Mauna Nani is a true showstopper. With stainless steel modern appliances, sleek finishes, and a backsplash that perfectly frames the mountain views. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the dining area, where a solid oak dining table with seating for 8 invites guests to gather for meals, conversation, and memories made around the table.

On the lower level, you’ll find even more ways to gather: a wet bar with a wine cooler, a poker table, and two king bedrooms with Smart TVs. Step outside to the private hot tub overlooking the mountains, the perfect place to unwind after a day of adventure. The top floor includes two more king bedrooms, both with Smart TVs, plus a fun loft with four twin beds that kids will love.

Every inch of Mauna Nani has been designed for both comfort and luxury. This is more than just a cabin; it’s a one-of-a-kind retreat built for creating unforgettable Smoky Mountain memories. Whether you’re cooking a feast in the gourmet kitchen, gathering around the dining table, challenging friends in the game room, enjoying movie night in the theater, or soaking in the hot tub under the stars, Mauna Nani is your dream mountain escape.

We are thrilled to welcome you to Mauna Nani, our newest cabin! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2000+ 5-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

LIVING AREAS
The living room at Mauna Nani is the perfect spot to relax and connect. It features a 3-seater couch and two additional chairs, arranged around a large seasonal electric fireplace (Oct–March) and Smart TV. Large windows let in plenty of natural light and offer beautiful mountain views. The open layout flows seamlessly to the dining area and outdoor decks, making it ideal for cozy evenings, family gatherings, or simply enjoying the view.

KITCHEN
The kitchen at Mauna Nani is a modern chef’s dream. Featuring stainless steel appliances, sleek countertops, and a backsplash framing stunning mountain views. Fully stocked with everything you need for a gourmet meal, including cookware, utensils, and serving pieces, the kitchen makes cooking a joy. It's open layout flows to the dining area with an 8-seat table, so you can cook, dine, and entertain all in one space while enjoying the company of family and friends.

DECKS
Step outside onto the spacious main-level decks at Mauna Nani, where breathtaking mountain views surround you. One deck features a private hot tub, the other offers ample seating and outdoor dining space for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or meals with family and friends. Whether you’re soaking in the hot tub, enjoying the fresh mountain air, or simply taking in the scenery, the decks provide the perfect place to unwind and make memories in the Smokies.

MULTIPLE RECREATION AREAS-
Mauna Nani offers multiple recreation areas designed for fun and relaxation for all ages. The main-level game room, located just off the deck, features a full-size pool table that flips into an air hockey table, foosball, and six multi-game arcade consoles—perfect for friendly competitions. A poker table and wet bar with a wine cooler add even more entertainment options. For movie lovers, the cabin also features a private home theater, ideal for family movie nights or binge-watching your favorite shows. With so many spaces for fun and entertainment, everyone can find their favorite way to unwind while enjoying the stunning mountain views.

The first floor:
• TVs in all bedrooms
• Hot Tub with stunning views of the mountains
• Full-size washer and dryer
• Poker table
• Wet bar with wine cooler

Main floor (2nd story):
• Large living room, the heart of the cabin, with a Smart TV
• Large electric fireplace (Oct-March)
• Large outdoor decks with stunning views and ample outdoor seating and dining.
• TVs located in all bedrooms on the main level
• A home theater to watch your favorite movies.
• Game room featuring a garage-style door, a full-size pool table that flips over into an air hockey table, 6 multigame arcade games, and a foosball table.

Top Floor (3rd Story):
• TV in both king bedrooms

BEDROOMS
Each of the 7 bedrooms offers plush bedding, luxurious finishes, and custom finishes, ensuring your stay is as restful as it is memorable.

Main Level (sleeps 4 people)
• Primary bedroom with a king bed, Smart TV, and an ensuite bathroom with a custom vanity, large walk-in shower, and a heated toilet seat
• Bedroom with a king bed and Smart TV
• Shared hall bathroom with custom vanity, walk-in shower, and a heated toilet seat

Lower floor (sleeps 4 people)
• King bedroom with Smart TV
• Shared hall bathroom with a custom vanity, a stand-up shower, and a heated toilet seat
• King bedroom with Smart TV

Top floor (sleeps 8 people):
• A king bedroom with a Smart TV
• A loft with 4 twin beds
• A king bedroom with a Smart TV
• Shared hall bathroom with a custom vanity, shower-tub combo, and a heated toilet seat

ADDITIONAL AMENITIES –
• Cozy Hot tub in the mountain air
• Game Room featuring 6 multigame arcade systems, a pool table that flips into an air hockey table, and foosball
• Theatre with theatre-style seating
• Electric Fireplace
• High-speed Wi-Fi internet access
• Full-size washer and dryer
• Parking for 5 standard-size vehicles.
• Access to Chalet Village Facilities which include 3 different clubhouses, three separate pool facilities including water-slide, a children’s play fountain, four tennis courts, pickleball courts, two game rooms with pool table, foosball, air hockey, arcade games, children’s play structure, concession stands & more. These facilities are included with your stay, with seasonal swimming pools available from Memorial Day through Labor Day.
• Convenient location, less than 4 miles from downtown Gatlinburg, and access to all the area has to offer which includes its great restaurants, shopping & Smoky Mountain National Park.
• Only 11 Miles to Pigeon Forge & 12 miles away from the entrance to Dollywood/Splash Country!
• Heating & A/C on the main and lower level. The top floor has turbo AC boosters.

They include 2 trash bags, 2 dishwasher pods, a paper towel roll, a small liquid dish soap bottle, toilet paper, a small bottle of shampoo, body lotion, body wash, conditioner, and a soap bar for each bathroom, towels, bed, and linens. They are designed so that you are all set when you arrive but not to last the entire trip
• Our proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park mean...

We continue to take extra precautions to ensure extra cleanliness and prioritize guest safety:

• All hard & soft surfaces cleaned with Micro-Ban™ including counters, vanities, sinks, floors, stair rails, cabinets, doors, furniture, beds, pillows, carpets, comforters, etc. throughout the cabin.
• Lysol™ is used thoroughly on all compatible surfaces to clean and disinfect
• Bleach-based cleaners used in all bathrooms and kitchens, that allow the use of chlorine products.
• Linens (bedding, towels, etc.) – removed & washed offsite in temperatures exceeding those recommended for laundry operations, then packaged until the housekeeping staff is ready to put them out for guests.
• Hot Tub -- Drained, cleaned, fresh Bromine added and refilled after every guest
• The cabin is inspected regularly after cleaning and inspectors perform additional applications of protective products in the cabin, such as MicroBan and Lysol.
• Cleaning staff received additional education on disinfection protocols and are furnished with protective gloves, changing them for fresh pairs as needed during cleaning & disinfection of the home.

### Accessibility and Availability

#### Neighborhood

The cabin is in the premier community of Chalet Village, Gatlinburg, Tennessee, and our property is adjacent to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park. The views from the cabin of the Great Smoky Mountains are breathtaking and we are only 3 miles from downtown Gatlinburg and the entrance to the Smoky Mountains National Park!

Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, foxes, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer, and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. We also contract regular monthly pest services which treat all pests from multiple types of bugs, mice, etc. Despite our regular treatments, given the proximity of the cabin to the park, it is possible these pests can temporarily enter the cabin. We immediately respond and treat if anything comes up and have found it is rare to come across anything like this.

When you've had enough relaxation, look forward to endless entertainment in the surrounding area; you'll be in the perfect spot to explore through winding hiking trails and world-class ski slopes in the Great Smoky Mountains. Other local attractions can be found in downtown Gatlinburg, including delectable restaurants, intriguing shops, the always-entertaining alpine slides, and even a moonshine distillery! During your time here, make sure to visit the Ober Gatlinburg Amusement Park & Ski Area, which offers terrific skiing in the colder months, a ski mountain coaster, an aerial tramway, and many other thrilling attractions!

The cabin is located on a mountain road. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter since there are no refunds for snow and ice. In difficult winter or storm-related weather situations, there can be delays in cleaning and check-in pending road conditions which can be outside of our control.

#### Guest Access

Our guests will have the full house to themselves! This is a private rental that shares no spaces other than the HOA community pool, tennis courts and gym.

Book your stay

#### Gatlinburg, TN, United States

Many of our guests drive to Gatlinburg Tennessee, but some also choose to fly into the Knoxville airport, McGhee Tyson Airport 44 miles away. We highly recommend that our guests have a vehicle for transportation. There's just so much to see and do in Gatlinburg and the surrounding areas! The driveway has ample parking for 4 standard size SUVS.
